description:
WARNING: Every action here changes what the public sees or is a legal act, some irreversible. `archive` permanently takes the passport off public view (its URL shows an archive notice; only an authority access grant still reads it). `record_registration` records the economic operator's registration in the production EU DPP Registry and locks the passport's operator and facility identifiers. `place_on_market` submits a registration to an EN 18222 registry API. The assistant MUST confirm with the user before each call. Use `suspend` (reversible — public QR shows 'suspended') as the safe alternative to archive when a change might need to be undone; a passport placed on the market cannot be suspended, because it must stay public.

EU DPP REGISTRY: the operator registers a battery passport itself, on the Registry website under its own EU Login; TracePass never submits to the Registry and never verifies the outcome. The acceptance environment has no legal effect; only a production registration counts. Paid plan; a connected app (OAuth) must act for an admin or owner. Refusal codes: resource tracepass://reference/lifecycle.

Actions (pass via `action`; `{…}` is the `args` object). All are WRITEs (1 write each). A *_by_serial action takes { serial, gtin? } instead of `id` (on 409 ambiguous_serial pass `gtin`).
- record_registration — { id, placedOnMarketAt? (YYYY-MM-DD), registrationId? }. Battery, published only. Records that the operator has registered this passport in the PRODUCTION EU DPP Registry, as the operator states it; TracePass does not check it. Confirm with the user first, and only after the operator has registered on the Registry website. Effects: marked placed on the market; operator and facility identifiers locked (409 operator_locked); webhook fires.
- undo_registration — { id, environment: production|acceptance }. Undoes a mistaken record; production unlocks the operator identifiers (a delivered webhook is not recalled). Changes nothing in the Registry. Confirm with the user first.
- place_on_market — { id }. Battery, published only. Submits to the EN 18222 registry API in the account's registry settings. NOT the way into the EU DPP Registry, which does not accept it: use prepare_registry_upi / prepare_registry_upload_file, then record_registration. A legal act for the economic operator — confirm with the user first. ASYNCHRONOUS: answers 202 "placing"; follow placeOnMarketStatus (placing → placed | rejected) by reading the passport. 409 codes include registry_host_not_allowed (the configured registry address is not allowed; check the URL) and registry_not_ready (run registry_readiness).
- suspend, suspend_by_serial — { id }. Reversible — public QR shows 'suspended'. Refused with 409 passport_placed_on_market once the passport is placed on the market or its registration is under way.
- archive, archive_by_serial — { id, reason? }. IRREVERSIBLE and destructive — confirm with the user first. Its URL then shows an archive notice (machine formats 404); only an authority grant still reads it. reason is REQUIRED for battery passports (400 reason_required): recycled, never_placed (never placed on the market or put into service) or duplicate_or_error; never_placed is refused (409 reason_contradicts_placement) once placed on the market.
- archive_product — { id }. Archives a PRODUCT (not a passport). Reversible — soft-archives it from the catalogue. 409 while any non-archived passport references it; archive those first.

action.description: All actions require user confirmation. archive is IRREVERSIBLE (public URL becomes an archive notice); suspend is reversible.

title: TracePass passport lifecycle (irreversible actions)
